Plot package statistics in the console

Source: R/pkg_plot.R
pkg_plot.Rd

Draw Unicode bar charts of results from pkg_structure(), pkg_lines() or pkg_summary() directly in the console. Calling plot() on any of these results does the same.

Usage

pkg_plot(
  x,
  type = c("package", "metric"),
  text_col = "#4670D4",
  bar_col = "#4670D4",
  bg_col = NULL,
  glyph = "█",
  start = "▏",
  end = "▕",
  max_bars = NULL,
  title = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'pkginspectr_tbl'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A result of pkg_structure(), pkg_lines() or pkg_summary(). Any data frame with a package column and numeric columns also works.

type

"package" for one panel per package, or "metric" for one panel per metric comparing packages.

text_col, bar_col

Colours for text and bars: a hex code such as "#4670D4" or a colour name. NULL uses the terminal's default colour.

bg_col

Optional background colour for the whole chart. NULL (the default) leaves the terminal background unchanged.

glyph

Character used to fill the bars. Must be a single-width character; wide characters such as emoji are replaced by a heavy horizontal line.

start, end

Characters drawn at the start and end of each bar. Use "" for no caps.

max_bars

Maximum bar width in characters. Defaults to 40 for type = "package" and 25 for type = "metric". Bars shrink to fit narrow consoles.

title

Title shown above the chart. NULL (the default) chooses one based on the data; "" shows no title.

...

Arguments passed on to pkg_plot().

Value

x, invisibly.

Details

There are two views:

  • type = "package" draws one panel per package. Bars show each metric's share of the package total: num_files for file counts and total_lines for line counts. num_dirs counts folders rather than files, so it is shown without a bar.

  • type = "metric" draws one panel per metric, comparing packages. Bars are scaled to the largest value of each metric, so the biggest package always gets a full bar.

Examples

lines <- pkg_lines(pkginspectr_example())
#> Counting lines in examplepkg...

# One panel per package
pkg_plot(lines)
#> ── pkginspectr: Lines of code ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── examplepkg 1.2.3 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Lines (share of total_lines)
#> total_lines     32  100.0%  ▏████████████████████████████████████████▕
#> code_lines      21   65.6%  ▏██████████████████████████▕
#> comment_lines    2    6.2%  ▏██▕
#> roxygen_lines    4   12.5%  ▏█████▕
#> blank_lines      5   15.6%  ▏██████▕
#> r_lines         25   78.1%  ▏███████████████████████████████▕
#> test_lines       7   21.9%  ▏█████████▕
#> other_lines      0    0.0%  ▏▕
#> function_lines   7   21.9%  ▏█████████▕
#> 

# The same, via plot()
plot(lines)
#> ── pkginspectr: Lines of code ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── examplepkg 1.2.3 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Lines (share of total_lines)
#> total_lines     32  100.0%  ▏████████████████████████████████████████▕
#> code_lines      21   65.6%  ▏██████████████████████████▕
#> comment_lines    2    6.2%  ▏██▕
#> roxygen_lines    4   12.5%  ▏█████▕
#> blank_lines      5   15.6%  ▏██████▕
#> r_lines         25   78.1%  ▏███████████████████████████████▕
#> test_lines       7   21.9%  ▏█████████▕
#> other_lines      0    0.0%  ▏▕
#> function_lines   7   21.9%  ▏█████████▕
#> 

# One panel per metric, for comparing packages
pkg_plot(lines, type = "metric")
#> ── pkginspectr: Lines of code ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> total_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕ 32
#> 
#> code_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕ 21
#> 
#> comment_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕  2
#> 
#> roxygen_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕  4
#> 
#> blank_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕  5
#> 
#> r_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕ 25
#> 
#> test_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕  7
#> 
#> other_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏▕  0
#> 
#> function_lines
#> examplepkg  ▏█████████████████████████▕  7
#> 

# Restyle the bars
pkg_plot(lines, bar_col = "darkorange", glyph = "=", start = "[", end = "]")
#> ── pkginspectr: Lines of code ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── examplepkg 1.2.3 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Lines (share of total_lines)
#> total_lines     32  100.0%  [========================================]
#> code_lines      21   65.6%  [==========================]
#> comment_lines    2    6.2%  [==]
#> roxygen_lines    4   12.5%  [=====]
#> blank_lines      5   15.6%  [======]
#> r_lines         25   78.1%  [===============================]
#> test_lines       7   21.9%  [=========]
#> other_lines      0    0.0%  []
#> function_lines   7   21.9%  [=========]
#>
